name: partner-sa-session-builder
description: Two audiences, one branded template. For solutions architects: technical session decks and demo flows adapted to the partner's data platforms, Fivetran sources, vertical, and fluency. For partner managers: business-value decks driven by real Partner BVA runs, showing services revenue, client value, and whether the partner's team can deliver it. Includes a monthly currency check and a verification gate before any deck is called ready.
